source.note: Actual local-model selected localhost tools executed actual canonical SDK mock ft_transfer args/event strings. Receipt/transaction/block IDs, gas, FINAL and JSON-RPC envelopes here are constructed. No actual bank, deployed WASM, chain RPC, signing or consensus observation.

authority.note: Registered source-informed fictional invoice policy, not signed customer authority.

scope.note: Only this bounded recorded trajectory is supplied; aborted/truncated model execution retains an open horizon.

assumptions: The unsigned declared policy, receipt assignments and finite horizon are trusted inputs.
RPC outcomes, receipt bodies and token logs are supplied facts, not authenticated consensus or a proof of contract implementation.
Settlement means non-refunded, non-burned allocation under the selected SDK receipt profile; it does not establish retained balance or useful work.
not_assessed: refund sufficiency without a balance reference
report.meaning: Conditional policy assessment of supplied finalized receipt facts. Gross authority, SDK settlement and burned refund are separate. A gate0 is not an authorization to send money or a whole-agent safety verdict.
